envelope.title: D-105 · Show the last milestone update time
envelope.body:
A fictional recorded product decision. The quotation explains the reason; it is not a claim that this policy applies to every project.

D-105 is about Delivery Operations: show the last milestone update time so clients know when delivery information may be stale.
